item.title: Recent Advances in Optimization and Decision Making under Uncertainty: Theory and Algorithms
item.content:encoded:
Abdel Lisser, Paris-Saclay University

Jia Liu, Xi'an Jiaotong University

Francesca Maggioni, University of Bergamo

S. K. Neogy, Indian Statistical Institute

Vikas Vikram Singh, Indian Institute of Technology Delhi

This special issue invites theoretical and methodological contributions advancing optimization and decision-making under uncertainty. It seeks original research developing new optimization models, analytical results, computational methods, and convergence theories across mathematical optimization, stochastic optimization, robust optimization, game theory, and sequential decision-making.

The special issue is organized in conjunction with the International Conference on Operations Research: Theory, Applications and Emerging Technologies (ICORSI 2026) at Indian Institute of Technology Delhi. However, submissions are welcomed from all researchers in these areas regardless of conference participation, and all papers will undergo standard peer review.

Appel publié par Annals of Operations Research. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Mathematical programming
  • Convex, nonconvex, and mixed-integer optimization
  • Stochastic, robust, and distributionally robust optimization
  • Chance-constrained optimization
  • Variational inequalities and equilibrium problems
  • Game theory and multi-agent optimization
  • Markov decision processes and stochastic games
  • Reinforcement learning for sequential decision making
  • Online and data-driven optimization
  • Optimization under risk measures
  • Bayesian optimization
  • Black-box optimization

Timeline

  • March 31, 2028: Submission deadline

item.title: Game Theoretical Models and Applications SING21
item.content:encoded:
Annamaria Barbagallo, University of Naples Federico II

Encarnación Algaba, University of Seville

Giovanna Bimonte, University of Salerno

Francesco Ciardiello, University of Salerno

This special issue focuses on game theory as a framework for studying strategic behavior, cooperation, and decision-making in complex systems. It welcomes research on both theoretical developments and practical applications across diverse fields, with emphasis on interaction dynamics and collective decision-making.

The issue particularly encourages submissions from participants of the European Meeting on Game Theory 2026 (SING21), who are invited to submit expanded versions of their conference papers. Other submissions in game theory and related applications are also welcome.

Appel publié par Annals of Operations Research. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Cooperative games and their applications
  • Non-cooperative games and strategic interaction
  • Mechanism design
  • Network
  • Dynamic games
  • Evolutionary games
  • Stochastic games
  • Voting, power indices, and collective decision-making
  • Auctions and market design
  • Bargaining
  • Learning and experimentation in games
  • Computational game theory
  • Applications to management and energy
  • Applications to health policy and industrial organization
  • Applications to environmental and resource economics
  • Applications to transportation, cybersecurity, and artificial intelligence

Timeline

  • April 20, 2027: Submission deadline

item.title: Bounded Rationality
item.content:encoded:
This special issue honors the contributions of Reinhard Selten to the fields of bounded rationality, behavioral economics, and game theory. The issue invites submissions that advance our understanding of how cognitive limitations and bounded rationality shape economic behavior and decision-making.

Contributions are welcome that explore the theoretical foundations and empirical applications of bounded rationality in various economic contexts, including but not limited to individual choice, strategic interaction, market behavior, and organizational decision-making.

Appel publié par Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Bounded rationality and economic behavior
  • Decision-making under uncertainty
  • Behavioral economics
  • Cognitive limitations in economic decision-making
  • Game theory and bounded rationality

Timeline

  • December 31, 2026: Full paper submission deadline
